sub_questions.question: Can the Team subscription be paid by invoice or bank transfer instead of credit card?

claims.claim: Credit card is the only payment method currently available on any Cloud plan.
claims.guide_evidence: Payment is by credit card by default; paying by invoice or bank transfer is still being evaluated by Dify ... it is not available on any plan today.

claims.claim: Dify is exploring a pay-by-invoice / bank transfer option.
claims.guide_evidence: paying by invoice or bank transfer is still being evaluated by Dify

claims.claim: If the invoice/bank transfer option ships, it is expected to apply only to annual Team subscriptions.
claims.guide_evidence: if it ships, is expected to be limited to annual Team subscriptions only

claims.claim: The invoice/bank transfer option is not available currently.
claims.guide_evidence: it is not available on any plan today.

evaluation.rationale: The answer correctly states that credit card is the only payment method today. It also correctly says that invoice or bank transfer is under evaluation and, if it ships, is expected to be limited to annual Team subscriptions. The closing suggestions (check the Billing page, contact sales) are optional advice, not entitlement claims, and they don't change the correct answer.
